Subject: Post-call recap + POC capacity planning next steps

Thanks again for the time today, Alex — great conversation about Acme's evaluation goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment:

Summary / success criteria (as discussed)
- End-to-end inference latency under 120ms p95 for the 2k token LLM workloads.
- Sustained throughput target: 40 qps for the classifier + generation mix during daytime tests.
- Accuracy baseline: parity or better vs current vendor on our 5 eval prompts (Priya will share the prompt set).
- No sensitive data leaves VPC during the trial; logs retained per your policy (90 days).

POC scope and timeline
- Trial window: 2 weeks of controlled runs followed by 1 week of stress/burst testing (target start: Apr 26).
- Phase 1 (days 1-7): functional validation and baseline perf.
- Phase 2 (days 8-14): load testing + autoscaling validation.

Capacity ask (we need your input to finalize):
- Reserved GPUs: recommend 4 x A100-40GB or equivalent for baseline sustained throughput.
- Autoscale headroom: allow burst to 8 GPUs for 30 minute windows up to 3x/day during stress tests.

Action items
- Priya: share the 5 evaluation prompts + traffic profile (rps, payload sizes) — by EOD 4/16.
- Rishi: will draft a capacity plan (reserved vs autoscale config) and an ops runbook for the POC by 4/19.
- Marissa: will send a draft mutual action plan and contract-friendly POC terms for review by 4/20.

Attachments: poc_requirements.pdf (Acme eval details) — please confirm receipt.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Marissa / team - looping in a draft capacity plan and ops runbook. High level:

- Baseline reserved capacity: 4 x A100-40GB (workload profile: mixed classification + generation). This gives the sustained 40 qps target with p95 latency headroom.
- Staging start (day 1-2): start with 2 reserved GPUs to validate config, then scale to 4 by day 3 automatically.
- Autoscaling policy: target CPU/GPU utilization threshold: 70% (scale up) / 35% (scale down) with a cooldown of 120s. Burst policy: allow on-demand burst up to +100% (up to 8 GPUs) for 30-minute windows; each burst requires prior notice via the MAPI but will be enabled automatically during the stress window.
- Warmup strategy: keep one standby replica with preloaded KV cache to reduce cold-start latency for model weights; recommend a 3-5 minute preload before scheduled bursts.
- Cost controls: set a daily burst cap (2 hours/day) and total POC budget cap; alerting will trigger at 70% of budget.

Attachments: capacity_estimate.xlsx, redwood_poc_runbook.docx

Questions for Acme:
- Confirm whether you prefer A100-80GB or 40GB instances (we priced both; 80GB reduces shard count).
- Confirm expected concurrency distribution (low/med/high) for the stress week so I can tune batch size and tokenization parallelism.

I'll incorporate Alex's notes about metrics streams (console vs Prometheus).

-Rishi
